order: Restructure checkout identity derivation to rely on git's own worktree records instead of filesystem path lookup. Snapshot the porcelain worktree list across the add operation so the single new entry becomes the identity and the working handle; real-path lookup must never touch the identity path. Fix the finding where removing the alias a checkout was created through strands the canonical registration, because the fail-closed cleanup path does not run in that case. Make creation, sweep, and teardown all address git's own spelling of the path, not a resolved alternative. Ambiguous records refuse the operation fail-closed rather than guessing. Teardown clears both parent path spellings behind a prefix guard, not just one. Also gate the timed-out lock guard: when a lock wait times out, forcibly terminate the child process and skip the kill-dependent sub-checks rather than killing into a state that can no longer be reclaimed.
claims: The linked-worktree porcelain list is snapshotted across the add so the new entry is the identity and the working handle; real-path lookup is removed from the identity path, and creation, sweep, and teardown all address git's own spelling, with ambiguous records refusing fail-closed and teardown clearing both parent spellings behind a prefix guard. The timed-out lock guard now force-kills the child and skips kill-dependent sub-checks. Suites: verifier 100, router 135, registry 31, review-lane 116 (twice), full CI-equivalent run green.
